text: 5. Code of the Witch of Justice: Even the Enemy's Justice Is Justice!
"Argh... Long, long ago,//n//nan evil witch was laid to rest on the outskirts of One Han City.//n//nHer lingering spirit turned into a phantom, forever searching for a way to achieve resurrection."
Yuzu
...One fateful day, the phantom stumbled upon an artifact and brought down a terrible hex upon the world.//nAny living creature touched by the cursed rain saw their spark of life slowly drain away...
Thankfully, the Witch of Justice and her three trusty companions stepped in just in time!
The defeated phantom is fleeing with its tail between its legs!//nOur mission, as the Squad of Justice, is to –
capture that wicked entity and ensure lasting peace for One Han City!
Trick or treat!
Little Girl
Haha! If we do this, does that mean we can catch the evil phantom?
Amusement Park - Halloween Grounds
Your smile is actually the most powerful spell of all. Here, have some candy!
Young Mother
Miyabi–!
Miyabi
Yay, Mommy found me!
Wonderful! Make sure you stick close to her so you don't wander off again, alright?
You're surprisingly natural with kids.
Achievement unlocked: Halloween Volunteer of the Night.
Still, I wonder if that fate-obsessed fraud is actually onto something. She swore the phantom was hiding right here, but I've already turned this whole amusement park upside down...
Waaah, Miss Witch!
I wanted to give you this jack-o'-lantern, but Mommy said it fell sick because it suddenly stopped glowing...
Don't worry! Th-there's nothing wrong with that – it adds to the spooky Halloween vibe...
Wait a second... {var:player_nickname}, this jack-o'-lantern carries a trace of that evil phantom!
player
Excuse me, do you remember where the lantern went dark?
Let me think... Just now, when I passed by the haunted house...//nOh, thank you both so much for taking care of Miyabi. I don't even know how to repay you!
Argh! This lantern is already the best gift ever! Thanks, little one, you just did the Witch of Justice a huge favor!
{var:player_nickname}, target locked on the haunted house! Squad of Justice, move out!
Visitor A
(Yawning) So boring... This haunted house isn't scary in the slightest.
Amusement Park - Haunted House
Visitor B
Right? I thought they'd put a little extra effort into Halloween...
Haunted House Staff
If ordinary people find it snooze-worthy, then this place will be child's play for the Witch of Justice!
See? Nothing scary at all –
Falling Spider Prop
Bzzt! Whirrr!
(Gently stroke her hair to calm her down)
I'm right here. Don't be scared.
I-I wasn't scared! I was just calling it out to warn you...
Still, a giant spider dropped out of nowhere just now... Why didn't anyone else even flinch?
Now that you mention it... those visitors ahead didn't even pause. It's as if they didn't care at all...
No, something is very wrong here.
(Sniffing) I knew it! The stench of the evil phantom...!
A haunted house that isn't scary, plus the presence of an evil phantom...
Could everyone's strange behavior be tied to that phantom?
I get it now! The phantom swallowed up everyone's fear, which is why this place feels so dull to them!
Mystery solved!
Then why did you get scared?
...Argh! That was a trick question! You set me up!
Whatever, that's beside the point!
Soft light radiates from her staff, sweeping across the entire building.
Visitors
AHHH! HOLY–!!!!
The stench is getting stronger... This way!
Amusement Park - Food Street
The food street is packed, yet the atmosphere is strangely subdued – almost eerily calm.
Customer at Popular Stall
(Muttering) I've been in line for an hour and haven't had a bite. Feeling dizzy and lightheaded... Guess I'm practically a ghost now. Talk about immersive Halloween vibes...
Customer at Roasted Sweet Potato Stall
(Biting into a blackened sweet potato) Huh, completely charred... Well, nom, nom, at least it's chewy.
Cotton Candy Vendor
(Monotone) Cotton candy isn't sweet at all. The recipe's a bust. Whatever – if it doesn't sell, it doesn't sell. I'll just call it paying for the experience.
This whole situation...
is way too peaceful, don't you think?
is getting seriously creepy.
Argh! So you noticed how bizarre this is too!
Argh! So you felt the danger lurking here too!
Look at that guy – his sweet potato is charred black, yet he doesn't even care how terrible it tastes! What if it gives him food poisoning?
Argh... Anger, sadness, discontent – these negative feelings serve a vital purpose.//nThey are signals telling us, "There's a baddie nearby!" or "This place needs justice!"
...Phew, looks like everyone's back to normal.
Argh! A noisy, lively crowd – that's what a real festival should feel like!
It led right here... Wait, why did the aura suddenly vanish?
Amusement Park - Parade Route
Staff
Oh no, what are we gonna do?! The parade float... the ghost...
Ah, that kind of ghost...
Just stand on the float and create some cute, magical moments for the kids!
Well... My Code doesn't say I have to accept every single request that comes my way. Can I pass on this one...?
Please don't! So many kids are looking forward to seeing the cute ghost...
I don't mind helping people find lost items or carry heavy stuff...
Relax. You're at your cutest when you're just being yourself.
Safeguarding the kids' smiles is a form of justice too, you know.
I-is that so...? Hmph...! Fine then, I suppose I can take on this request – just this once!
Argh-gh... My formidable majesty as the Witch of Justice is totally gone... That phony fortune-teller better never see me like this...
Those kids over there are already smiling at you.
(Straightening up)
...Hmph, alright, alright! Ghost of Justice, r-rolling out!
Standing on the parade float, Yuzu does her best to shower the kids with candy,//nall while keeping a watchful eye out for any sign of the phantom.

Yet by the time the float reaches the end of the route, it is still nowhere to be seen.//nWe are met only with the children's innocent laughter and cheering,//nleaving our sole lead dead in the water.
The carousel... the roller coaster... the graveyard... the haunted house... the food street... the parade...
A Quiet Corner of the Amusement Park
Impressive. The Witch of Justice came through for so many people today.
It's all in a day's work for me, but still...
We've scoured almost the entire park! And we haven't even caught a whiff of that phantom!
Is it really going to end up playing right into that phony fortune-teller's prophecy?
Still dwelling on what Kaavi said this afternoon?
So this is where the prophecy said the phantom would show up! Let's split up and hunt it down!
Kaavi
There is no need.//nThe threads of fate have already been spun. When midnight strikes, the fugitive will walk right into its cage on its own.
The tarot never lies. No such thing will come to pass.
Her way of doing things rubbed me the wrong way, which is why I insisted on striking out on my own.
But if all this searching turns up empty...
Keep up the hunt. We're bound to turn up something.
Maybe staking out the plaza would be more efficient at this point.
Don't lose heart. We already know what that phantom is after. It feeds on people's negative emotions to stay alive, so sticking to its trail will definitely yield better results.
That's true... So where would it go looking for bad vibes right about now?
Aside from the cotton candy vendor who messed up his recipe and the visitors disappointed by the haunted house, pretty much everyone at the park is having a blast on Halloween night, right?
Just a moment ago, its trail led straight to the parade.//nThat's supposed to be the happiest event in the whole park – there shouldn't be any "food" for it there. Why head in that direction?
...Maybe it intends to whip up its own "food"?
Whip it up...? Argh, this is where the crowd is thickest! If panic breaks out here, it'll have a never-ending buffet of fear...
Oh no! The floats are about to make their return run, and that's when the crowd peaks. {var:player_nickname}, we have to hurry!
Staff
Float Driver
Come to me... your fear... your anguish... All your negative emotions shall become my sustenance!
The parade float careens wildly toward the crowd!
Yuzu, look over there!
A shadowy figure, almost indistinguishable from the night, leaps nimbly across the banners and lanterns hanging above the crowd.
{var:player_nickname}, after it!!
Yuzu grabs my hand and pulls me into the sea of people –//n//ndodging past oncoming tourists...//n//nand slipping straight through a flaming hoop set up for an acrobatic show...
It went that way –
...Wait, isn't that Kaavi's fortune-telling booth up ahead?
Hold your steps, hurried traveler.
Amusement Park - Central Plaza
After waiting in line for so long, turning back now would be a dreadful waste of what fate has orchestrated.
Allow me to grant you a reading... The Tower, reversed. Heh, it seems blood and calamity await you tonight.
Eight spectral swords forged from starlight materialize out of thin air, forcing a dark shadow out of hiding and trapping it squarely within Kaavi's crystal ball!
Did... did it work?!
Crystal Ball
Inside the crystal ball, the shadow thrashes frantically.
How sturdy is that crystal ball of yours? It's looking pretty unstable...
BOOM!
Surrounding Visitors
Ugh... It's so cold... I want to go home...
Panic and aggression sweep through the crowd in an instant.//nSuddenly, the eyes of several bystanders go blank as an unnatural force takes hold of them.
Controlled Visitor
Quick! Get her, everyone!
The phantom feeds on negative emotions, and this entire illusion is sustained by all that negativity!
(Channeling mana to suppress the crystal ball) I see...
I've temporarily halted the illusion's spread. The crystal ball is its core – strike it with raw magical energy, shatter it, and the phantom will be destroyed.
Do it.
(Looking pale) ...Stop wasting time on futile attempts. Fate dictates that this is the most efficient solution.
Argh, here you go again... The word "fate" doesn't even exist in my Code of Justice!
...You spent the whole day running around the park, only to wind up right back here. Even your precious code is etched into the palm of fate.
...So what if it is? As long as I stay true to the justice in my heart, I'll make this so-called fate serve justice too!
I've upheld justice throughout the entire park today, and that means you're under my protection too, dummy fortune-teller!
Don't you dare think I'd ever turn my back on someone who needs my help!!
...Heh. So I'm under your umbrella of justice too...?
Even after all this time as an apprentice, you're still just a laughably naive, hopelessly stubborn little furball.
Phony fortune-teller, you never intended to merely contain the phantom in your crystal ball, did you? You must have a way to purify it afterward. Out with it!
...Very well. I do possess a purification spell.
However, the negative emotions of everyone inside this realm are constantly fueling it. It will continue feeding on those feelings and regenerating endlessly.
If we keep this stalemate going, it won't be long before my magic is completely drained, leaving us in a far worse predicament.
Argh, so it's a battle of attrition...
So the key is cutting off its supply.
But how do we turn everyone's mood around?
...Maybe it's not that complicated?
Do you have another brilliant idea, {var:player_nickname}?!
Your little ghost act put smiles on everyone's faces earlier.
What if we convince them that none of this is real danger – that it's all just a "special performance"?
...Oh! If they think it's all part of the show, they won't be frightened anymore! Let's give it a shot... Hey, phony fortune-teller!!
I hear you. I'll focus all my power on purifying the phantom. How much time I have depends entirely on you two.
Hmph... Just sit back and watch!
Dropping her protective barrier, Yuzu throws her arms wide to face the restless crowd.
(Eagerly awaiting applause) ...
Yawning Visitor
What a snoozefest... Just another tired ghost-busting cliché.
Impatient Visitor
What a joke. I just came to have fun – let us out of here!
Eye-Rolling Visitor
The practical effects are kinda neat, but that dialogue is straight out of a bargain bin!
H-how did it flop this hard?!
Crack–
Panicking Visitor
A surge of malicious energy ripples through the air.//nTendrils of pure malice rise from the crowd, coalescing into solid spikes that rain down on Kaavi's crystal ball!
C-come forth, my adorable familiars!
Red Panda Squad
The sudden arrival of the red pandas instantly takes the edge off the crowd's hostility.
Heh-heh, cuteness is justice!
Crackle-clack–
Controlled Visitors
I-I am NOT an evil witch!! {var:player_nickname}, what do we do?!
Forget the witch playbook. How about we tell our story?
Our... story?
Another wave of dark energy comes hurtling straight at us –
Watch out!
(Perfect time to grab their attention!)
(Pretend to be hit!)
Ngh...!
I stagger back a few steps and collapse at Yuzu's feet.
...{var:player_nickname}!!
Yuzu drops to her knees and gathers me into her arms, her eyes instantly filling with tears.
The dramatic fall immediately grabs the onlookers' attention, and the entire audience falls silent.
(Quietly) ...Don't panic.
(Quietly) It's just a show. I'm fine.
(Quietly) ...You scared the life out of me!
(Quietly) We've got their full attention – now's our chance.
(Quietly) Keep going while we still have them.
(Quietly) Just speak from the heart.
(Quietly) Like when you played the little ghost.
(Quietly) Genuine feelings are what move people.
(Weakly open your eyes and gaze at Yuzu)
(Offer a faint smile and wipe the tears from the corners of her eyes)
I'm okay... After all, we're... partners... aren't we?
P-partners...
I used to think the Witch of Justice never needed human companions...
But ever since you came along... I realized... having you around isn't so bad after all...
And after everything we've been through... I haven't even properly thanked you.
Thanks for sticking by my side, {var:player_nickname}.
So, am I officially your partner now?
...Y-you don't have to spell it out like that! Just keep it to yourself!
Amused Visitor
Someone in the crowd chuckles at her flustered, blushing reaction, prompting a wave of warm, genuine laughter from the audience.
Now's our chance!
Right!
Helping me "struggle" back to my feet, she calls out to the crowd.
My partner has been struck down by a dark curse! I need your power to save them!
Touched Visitors
Tell us what to do!
The law of Halloween dictates: trick or treat! And right now, an "evil witch" is trying to play a wicked trick on my partner – it's her!
(Quietly) Just play along!
(Deadpan) Heh... heh... heh. I am the legendary Evil Witch of Calamity. Give up. Your companion is doomed to an eternal nightmare...
I won't let you have your way!
Enthusiastic Visitors
Yeah!!
Little Boy

The crowd erupts into excitement as, one by one, the people she helped begin to share their stories.//nEach spoken word transforms into a speck of golden light, rising into the air until they merge into a brilliant river of stars, sweeping directly toward her!
Argh! Behold the power of justice!
Well played. The purification spell is almost ready...
As Kaavi channels gentle magic into the orb, Yuzu guides the surging joy toward it. The two forces intertwine, purging the phantom from the crystal ball. It tries to flee –
Fleeing Phantom
Visitor C
Visitor D
That mysterious fortune-teller vanished too... Part of the act, maybe?
Word of that night's "special performance" spread like wildfire,//n//ncementing itself as the park's most talked-about Halloween tale.
And so, the gloom hanging over One Han City was swept away once more through the combined efforts of the Witch of Justice and her partner.
Future adventures undoubtedly await, but tonight belongs to celebration.
Argh-argh! A resounding victory for justice!
Your search wasn't for nothing – you solved a ton of problems for the visitors along the way.
Still, Kaavi said the phantom would manifest in the central plaza at midnight, and we're getting close to the hour. Why don't we go take a look? Catching that phantom is our top priority, after all.
Argh... Now...? Fine. Since the trail has gone cold everywhere else, let's check it out.
We leave the parade route and head back toward the central plaza.
But only moments later, piercing screams and the screech of tires shatter the night!
It's coming from the parade!

Out of breath, we rush back to find the float crashed against the curb, surrounded by panicked onlookers.//nThe phantom is gone, but its sinister aura still hangs heavy in the air, stronger now that it has feasted on the crowd's fear.
Plaza Visitor
Ahhh! That evil fortune-teller has lost her mind! Run!
Was she the one behind all that freaky stuff?! The whole plaza just turned into some kind of graveyard and a creepy forest...!
We track Kaavi down in a quiet corner. She looks drained, the crystal ball in her hands cobwebbed with deep cracks.
...Argh! What happened here?!
Nothing out of the ordinary. The phantom has been reclaimed. Fate unfolded exactly as it was meant to.
...Fate?! You've been branded an evil fortune-teller!
News Report

BREAKING: A dangerous disturbance was reported during last night's Halloween festivities at One Han City Amusement Park. The suspect, an unholy fortune-teller, fled the scene. Investigations are currently underway...
Damn it!
Attention everyone! Our next objective is to restore her reputation!//nKaavi might be a phony fortune-teller, but she's not an evil one!
And so, a new mission for justice begins.//nI can already tell that clearing Kaavi's name is going to be far harder than catching a rogue phantom...
By the night spirits' blessing, let our stolen thrills return!
Nectar of life, awaken these dormant emotions!
...Heh, she is precisely the one I have been waiting for. Tarot - Eight of Swords: Array of Binding!
...Tarot - Ace of Cups: Fate's Cleansing!
You're not escaping! Light of life, banish the shadows!
A-argh! You bet!
Thank you for telling me the story, Miss Witch! I have a present for you too!
Huh? F-for me? N-no need – whoa, don't run so fast! Watch your step!
Argh?! What's wrong?
How come? We literally just updated all our props...
Aaaaaaargh!! GIANT SPIDER!!! BEGONE!!!!
...She actually lost it so bad her hair fluffed up?
Argh-argh! Ruining everyone's Halloween experience is unforgivable. Justice will be served!
Huh? Screams! Finally, real screams in my haunted house!
Piece of cake! Wait... The phantom's energy is moving toward the food street! {var:player_nickname}, after it!
And that cotton candy vendor! He messed up the recipe and couldn't care less! At this rate, his stall will go out of business!
The phantom drained all of that away! Thank goodness we noticed, or this entire street would be doomed!
(Snapping out of it) Oh gosh, why is this line still so long?! My legs are completely numb! But I'm not giving up – I'm eating this today no matter what!
(Suddenly jolting) No way! I can't let my Halloween cotton candy be a disaster! I'm fixing this recipe right now!
(Spitting out burnt pieces) Yuck! Are you selling roasted sweet potatoes or lumps of charcoal?!
...Huh? The phantom's trail...
It's heading that way – toward the parade floats!
Showing your true colors at last! Evil phantom!
A Few Hours Earlier - Central Plaza, Amusement Park
Argh? You mean we just sit here twiddling our thumbs until midnight?! What if it attacks visitors in the meantime?!
WHOA! What's happening?! The float's out of control!
...It's the phantom! It's possessing the driver!
Everyone, clear the way! Spirits of the wind, clear the haze from this lost soul's mind!
(Slamming on the brakes) Wh-what just happened to me?!
Hey! Watch out for that thing!
Hummm... hummm... hummm...
Huh...? Wh-where am I...? Is this place haunted?!
Hey, stop shoving! You looking for a fight?!
It's her! That fortune-teller did this! She's an evil witch!
Hold it right there! Rings of the ancient tree, raise a barrier and buy us some time!
...No way! You'll get hurt! You dummy, did you forget your magic is currently linked straight to that ball?! We need another plan!
Argh! I'm eighteen years old! Stop calling me that! And who are you calling naive–
Argh! That's it! If we can stop everyone from being scared and get them smiling instead, it won't be able to recover!
Ladies and gentlemen! Get ready for a special Halloween surprise – a grand showdown between the Witch of Justice and the Witch of Evil!
...Wait, what? This whole mess is just a show?

(Thrusting her staff into the air) Ahem! Hark, for I am the Witch of Justice, sent by divine decree!//nEverything you see before you is part of a grand spectacle staged to capture a wicked spirit that has eluded us for a thousand years!
Boring! Screw this! Fraud!
Shoot! It's harvesting everyone's frustration!
Argh-gh-gh–!
The Red Panda Squad bursts onto the scene in spectacular fashion, blocking every last attack!
Whoa! Red pandas! They're so cute!
Who cares if they're cute?! Let us go!//nYou're in cahoots with that wicked fortune-teller, aren't you! Trying to trap us here!//nWitch of Justice? More like Witch of Evil!
(Quietly) H-how am I supposed to act?! What do I even say?!
D-dummy! Who told you to jump in front of me like that?! I could've handled it on my own...
Pfft–
Everyone! Think of the happiest moment you've had tonight, and together, let's turn that joy into candy and drive this "evil witch" away!
Me! The cute little ghost on the float gave me candy today!
Me! I ate the sweetest cotton candy ever!
I-I found my daughter! We got separated earlier, and that witch onstage took care of her! Thank you so much!
And our haunted house! She's the one who brought it back to life!
Curse you... This isn't over... AGHHH!
Whoa, what a show!
Is it over already? I wanted more...
Coming here tonight was the best decision ever! Huh? Where did the Witch of Justice and her partner go?
Argh... Shoot! It got what it wanted! The trail leads straight to... the central plaza! It's heading right for Kaavi!
Hmph! Even during a top-secret mission, no incident is too small if it catches my eye – all must face justice!
That's it! Fear, anxiety, frustration... My spellbook says that a wounded phantom feeds on negative human emotions to regain its strength!
(Puffing out her chest) Because I'm the Witch of Justice! Weak phantom aura like this could never numb my feelings!
Huh? Oh, I meant we're one actor short for the cute ghost on our float! Could you step in and fill the spot?
B-but acting... cute? I don't even know where to start!!
I... I only know how to use magic to fight and purify... I've never even heard of "happiness magic" before.
